definitions.explanation: The second-highest rank in professional sumo wrestling, just below yokozuna (grand champion). Achieving ōzeki requires consistently strong tournament results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大関|おおぜき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{大関|おおぜき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{次|つ}ぐ→次ぐ：02076_tsugu⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧だ。
examples.english: Ōzeki is the rank just below yokozuna.

examples.japanese: {大関|おおぜき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二場所|にばしょ}⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{負|ま}け{越|こ}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{関脇|せきわけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥落|かんらく}→陥落：14594_kanraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If an ōzeki has a losing record for two consecutive tournaments, they are demoted to sekiwake.

notes:
USAGE:
The sumo ranking system (⟦{番付|ばんづけ}→番付：15187_banzuke⟧) from top to bottom for the top division: ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧ (grand champion), {大関|おおぜき} (champion), {関脇|せきわけ} (junior champion), {小結|こむすび} (fourth rank). Historically, {大関|おおぜき} was the highest rank before ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧ was established as a separate rank.

Promotion to {大関|おおぜき} typically requires about 33 wins over three consecutive tournaments. Unlike ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧, an {大関|おおぜき} can be demoted for poor performance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大関|おおぜき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to ōzeki
- {大関|おおぜき}⟦{陥落|かんらく}→陥落：14594_kanraku⟧: demotion from ōzeki
- {大関|おおぜき}⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧: promotion to ōzeki
- カド{番|ばん}{大関|おおぜき}: ōzeki on probation (must win to keep rank)
